points: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind.

note.label: God's People Need Charity, Healing & Trust

points: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us. The abundance is the help that was given to them from the congregation, the way we get the booster club funds to go out and preach the gospel. That is an abundance that people are ministering to the prophets. And who has control of that? The leadership. So if the leadership is dealing falsely with the money, going and buying Bentleys like the churches and all that, then guess what? The people are not going to trust us with the money.

note.label: God's People Need Charity, Healing & Trust

points: So amongst us, our fail-safe is, old school, we do not touch the money. We have people who are over that. So nobody could say it is on us. Paul is going into that here: whenever they brought the offerings to Jerusalem, they always picked somebody that was of good report of the body, so he knew he had no bad intent, but he knew how other people can be when it comes to money. So you want to make sure that there is a process that the people can be confident in, so they know that we are stewarding their funds the right way. You cannot just have anybody touching and dealing with those matters. So sometimes when we tell you that there is privacy around those things, it is not because we are trying to be deceptive with you. Everybody has different types of spirits. There are certain men that deal with those offices, and they have backups upon backups, to make sure that even by themselves, we are not putting too much trust in one single person to deal with that abundance. You avoid people having, or even remotely thinking, that you are dealing unjustly, because we understand how people think.

Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men. Because we want it not just in the sight of the Lord, knowing that the Lord knows all things, but also in the sight of men. Men can see. As a leader you should be in a place where no man can blame you. Because it is a blight when people come in and they say, this is like the church, these brothers over here are doing this. You know that brother does not hold a job, right? He does not work, so how is he paying his bills? Look, he has a new pair, he has a new phone. And the ministry gets blamed.
